resources.string: Device pairing will be added in a later phase.
Your local identity stays the same until you reset it.
A public fingerprint of this device’s signing key.
Creates a new identity. Once pairing is available, you will need to pair your devices again.
This creates a new device ID and signing key. Once pairing is available, your other devices will need to pair with this device again.
Secure storage is unavailable. Unlock your device and try again. Your identity has not been replaced.
The saved signing key is missing or unusable. Try again, or reset this device’s identity to create a replacement.
The saved identity could not be read consistently. Try again, or reset it to create a replacement.
The identity could not complete its signing check. Try again, or reset it to create a replacement.
